data.hypothesis: Increasing the source-loop unroll factor from 64 to 128 may reduce loop-control overhead while preserving the baseline force expression and serial accumulation order. The unroll-64 candidate was correct and measured at 0.001790758 s; the incremental benefit of this change remains unmeasured.
data.notes: Only the source-loop unroll factor changes; launch.json and the baseline arithmetic remain unchanged. Prior timings are search measurements, not independent confirmation. The controller should freshly validate correctness and measure this candidate before deciding whether to retain it.
transformations: Preserve baseline force arithmetic, accumulation order, kernel interface, and launch configuration.
